topic: General privileges: bands, emissions and power (G1A, G1C; 18 pool questions)

questions.question: On which HF and/or MF amateur bands are there portions where General class licensees cannot transmit?
On which of the following bands is phone operation prohibited?
On which of the following bands is image transmission prohibited?
On which of the following frequencies are General class licensees prohibited from operating as control operator?
Which of the following applies when the FCC rules designate the amateur service as a secondary user on a band?

choices.A: Amateur stations must record the call sign of the primary service station before operating on a frequency assigned to that station
choices.B: Amateur stations may use the band only during emergencies
choices.C: Amateur stations must not cause harmful interference to primary users and must accept interference from primary users
choices.D: Amateur stations may only operate during specific hours of the day, while primary users are permitted 24-hour use of the band

questions.answer: Amateur stations must not cause harmful interference to primary users and must accept interference from primary users

questions.question: On which amateur frequencies in the 10-meter band may stations with a General class control operator transmit CW emissions?
Which HF bands have segments exclusively allocated to Amateur Extra licensees?

choices.C: All HF bands except 160 meters and 10 meters

questions.question: Which of the following frequencies is within the General class portion of the 15-meter band?
What portion of the 10-meter band is available for repeater use?

choices.B: The portion between 28.1 MHz and 28.2 MHz
choices.C: The portion between 28.3 MHz and 28.5 MHz

questions.question: When General class licensees are not permitted to use the entire voice portion of a band, which portion of the voice segment is available to them?

choices.C: The lower frequency portion on frequencies below 7.3 MHz, and the upper portion on frequencies above 14.150 MHz
choices.D: The upper frequency portion on frequencies below 7.3 MHz, and the lower portion on frequencies above 14.150 MHz

questions.question: What is the maximum transmitter power an amateur station may use on 10.140 MHz?
What is the maximum transmitter power an amateur station may use on the 12-meter band?

choices.D: An effective radiated power equivalent to 100 watts from a half-wave dipole

questions.question: What is the maximum bandwidth permitted by FCC rules for amateur radio stations transmitting on USB frequencies in the 60-meter band?
Which of the following is required by the FCC rules when operating in the 60-meter band?

choices.A: If you are using an antenna other than a dipole, you must keep a record of the gain of your antenna
choices.B: You must keep a record of the date, time, frequency, power level, and stations worked
choices.C: You must keep a record of all third-party traffic
choices.D: You must keep a record of the manufacturer of your equipment and the antenna used

questions.answer: If you are using an antenna other than a dipole, you must keep a record of the gain of your antenna

questions.question: What is the limit for transmitter power on the 28 MHz band for a General Class control operator?
What is the limit for transmitter power on the 1.8 MHz band?
What must be done before using a new digital protocol on the air?

choices.B: Obtain an experimental license from the FCC
choices.C: Publicly document the technical characteristics of the protocol
choices.D: Submit a rule-making proposal to the FCC describing the codes and methods of the technique

questions.answer: Publicly document the technical characteristics of the protocol

questions.question: What measurement is specified by FCC rules that regulate maximum power?
